en.authority: Likumi.lv / Official Publisher of the Republic of Latvia
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Latvian legal publication of the Latvia–Czech Republic tax treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner is a company directly holding at least 25 per cent of the payer’s capital and a 15 per cent ceiling in all other cases. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official treaty publication; the official text controls.

en.authority: Likumi.lv / Official Publisher of the Republic of Latvia
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Latvian legal publication of the Latvia–Czech Republic tax treaty provides a general 10 per cent source-State ceiling where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with residence-State-only taxation for qualifying government, political subdivision, local authority, central bank, wholly government-owned financial institution or government-guaranteed financing cases. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official treaty publication; the official text controls.

en.authority: Likumi.lv / Official Publisher of the Republic of Latvia
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Latvian legal publication of the Latvia–Czech Republic tax treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment or fixed-base effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise synthesis of the official treaty publication; the official text controls.
